assumptions.assumption: A decode-time intrinsic may reject even when its returned value is unused.
assumptions.basis: Pinned 2025-12 DecodeBitMasks Undefined conditions and four actual unsliced tuple assignments.
assumptions.stress_test: All 8192 immediate patterns in each of ORR/AND/EOR/DUPM and dead-result call mutations.
assumptions.falsification_probe: Any reserved pattern admitted or a valid logical immediate rejected.
assumptions.status: confirmed for the pinned input by exception-preserving slicing, 8192-pattern intrinsic tests, exact compression checks and primary decode derivation.

assumptions.assumption: The older 728-description corpus alone cannot qualify the newer implemented SVE2 surface.
assumptions.basis: Existing newer handlers, separate optional feature flags, and the 879-encoding sweep.
assumptions.dependent_result: Primary source selection and feature-qualified classification.
assumptions.stress_test: Match every sweep encoding to current primary descriptions, retain optional and streaming alternatives.
assumptions.falsification_probe: An implemented newer form loses admission or an absent feature still executes.
assumptions.status: confirmed: the modern source covers all 879 historical sweep words; 878 are admitted by represented features and the remaining FMMLA.D requires unrepresented FEAT_F64MM.

assumptions.assumption: Separate primary instruction predicates imply independent architectural features.
assumptions.basis: Separate IsFeatureImplemented names in the instruction XML.
assumptions.dependent_result: Proposed PMULL128 flag and initial independent-feature tests.
assumptions.stress_test: Cross-check the architecture feature dependency specification and ID register field semantics.
assumptions.falsification_probe: A primary dependency statement ties the supposedly independent features.
assumptions.status: falsified by Arm 109697_2025_12_en pages 119-120; remove the extra flag and bind both names to SVE2_AES.

assumptions.assumption: Scalar SME length execution represents a fixed implemented SVL of 128 bits, independently of normal SVE VL.
assumptions.basis: Existing vector storage is 128 bits; private-state validation rejects other represented SVE lengths. A fixed 128-bit SME maximum is an explicit implementation choice, not an inference that SVE and SME lengths must match.
assumptions.dependent_result: RDSVL, ADDSVL and ADDSPL scalar execution.
assumptions.stress_test: Signed six-bit immediate endpoints, SP/XZR, register overlap, wrapping and future length/profile writes.
assumptions.falsification_probe: Any accepted configuration or SMCR setting produces an effective implemented SME SVL other than 128 bits, or any of the 24 independent QEMU value cases differs.
assumptions.status: confirmed for the explicit fixed-128-bit implementation by 24 independent QEMU value replays and actual two/four-CPU file continuation; full variable-length/ID/system-register profiles remain open.

assumptions.assumption: A native region must retain the selected access-path capability in addition to its instruction allocation clause.
assumptions.basis: The primary conditional-predicate operation selects normal SVE access only with SVE2p1. Both the production bounded entry and the native test helper enforce region.fp_features independently of cache selection.
assumptions.dependent_result: Conditional-predicate native entry admission after selected-profile changes.
assumptions.stress_test: Allocate using the SME2 alternative with SVE2p1 present, establish a real integer-native positive control carrying those original requirements, then remove SVE2p1 and try the existing region.
assumptions.falsification_probe: The existing region executes, mutates guest state, or its requirements omit SVE2p1 after normal access was selected.
assumptions.status: confirmed within the tested native-entry profile: the frozen pre-fix source passed 16 tests and failed this guard; the corrected suite passed all 17. The fixture does not execute native SVE instructions.

assumptions.assumption: The historical base-SVE fixture profile cannot allocate every SDOT/UDOT destination-size pattern.
assumptions.basis: Pinned SDOT/UDOT base diagrams require 32/64-bit destinations. A separate 16-bit class requires SVE2p3 or SME2p3, neither selected by the historical helper. The 8-bit pattern has no matching canonical diagram.
assumptions.dependent_result: Correction of 68 generated allocation assertions without changing interpreter admission.
assumptions.stress_test: All 22 distinct rejected words under ZEN=0 and ZEN=3, four legal words under both controls, and 12 byte-identical positive test bodies.
assumptions.falsification_probe: A selected-profile primary class allocates a rejected word, QEMU executes it or reports an access trap, or a legal control is modified/rejected.
assumptions.status: confirmed by 52 independent QEMU observations and primary feature/diagram checks; the first full ARM run retained 68 failures. All corrected owning integration binaries passed.
